# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash-ref-low-delivery-timing

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

`coop --git` on `vertex_ai/gemini-3-flash-preview` at `low` thinking across the 50-pair `flash` subset under the frozen reference harness budgets (500 steps, compaction at 128K tokens, step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap, `-c 4` concurrency) with `delivery_timing: true` (`configs/variants/delivery_timing_ref_low.yaml`). This tests whether phase-aware message delivery (`delivery_timing`) still improves `gemini-3-flash-preview` once the 28K compaction bottleneck is removed by the 128K reference threshold, comparing directly against [`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash-ref-low`](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash-ref-low/summary.md).

## Observations

- **13/50 (26%) passed (11/50 clean-merge passes, 20 merge conflicts, 0 step-limit cutoffs, 0 compactions)** at `$22.66` (`58` min, `4` rate-limit retries), compared to **17/50 (34%, 16/50 clean-merge, 17 conflicts)** on the matched 500-step / 128K `gemini-3-flash-preview` baseline (`+6` pair wins, `-10` pair losses).
- **Why `delivery_timing`'s earlier +14pp gain at 28K compaction disappears at 128K compaction on `gemini-3-flash-preview`**: at 28K compaction (`114–119` compactions per run), deferring non-urgent messages during active coding turns prevented mid-turn inbox injections from inflating prompt context and triggering destructive 28K compactions (`23/50` vs. `16/50`). At 128K compaction (`0–2` compactions per run across `5,305–5,348` steps, median `50` steps/agent), neither run compacts, and deferring messages during short (~50-step) `gemini-3-flash-preview` coding bursts delays coordination until one agent has already committed and submitted (`812` total messages vs. `895` in the 128K baseline).
